title: 第20章 三堂主第21章 收服五口堂
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
时间点一点的过去了，大概过了半个时辰的样子，外面终于传来了脚步声，然后轰的一声房门直接被打爆了，一个人冲了进来。
这是一个一身白衣，黑发黑瞳的青年，青年面色冷峻，他正是陈峰。
“我来了，周堂主。”
陈锋一眼就看到了坐在别墅大厅里老虎椅子上，被很多人簇拥着周天雄。
“你小子胆子不小，竟然单枪匹马来闯五口堂，你以为你是关羽啊，给我干死他。”
看到陈锋后，周天雄恶狠狠的道，活了这么多年周天雄是第一次碰到陈锋这么嚣张的人，他感觉很奇怪，也非常生气。
如果今天不干掉陈锋，他简直没办法混了。
在周天雄的命令下，那些第四分堂的武者，纷纷手持武器，或者乱起双拳朝着陈锋冲来打算击杀他。
一时间，杀声震天，陈锋直接被这么多五口堂的人围住了。
面对这些人的攻击，陈锋身体快速闪烁起来，躲过这些人的攻击。陈锋毕竟是修仙者神念强大，他反应敏捷是这些武者的很多倍，躲过他们攻击自然容易。
这些帮派武者手中的刀子，长剑，锤子，拳头都压根打不到他，总是距离他的身体差一点点。
陈锋没有动手，他反而背着双手他忽然闪烁到了其中一个内劲入门弟子身后，将嘴巴凑到了对方脑袋后面，他伸出了舌头，舌头直接打在了对方的后脑勺上。
砰！
一声响，对方后脑勺直接被陈锋的舌头打穿了，脑浆迸裂当场死亡。
而看到这一幕，所有的第四分堂武者都惊呆了，舌头杀人，他们是第一次见过。
陈锋再接再厉，身体闪烁起来，每次都闪到了敌人的身边或者身后，他张嘴用舌头攻击，就和毒蛇一样。
砰！
砰！
因为陈锋速度太快旁人压根来不及躲闪，瞬间功夫地面上就躺了一地尸体，这些武者都是被陈锋用舌头打穿了太阳穴，或者是打穿后脑勺，死的是不能在死了。
他们自然不知道陈锋是修仙者，他在真气灌入下他的舌头也变成了骇人的杀人利器，比刀子还要锋利的。

“我草，这尼玛，你属蛇的啊。”
看到自己的手下全部挂了，被陈锋用舌头捅死了，周天雄气的疯了，也觉得无语，他是第一次看到这么杀人的。
陈锋为什么要用舌头杀人，不是因为他属蛇，那是因为他以前看过一部日本动漫，里面的杀手就是这么杀人的，他就是想要模仿一下觉得好玩，觉得这种杀人方法逼格很高。
“拼了！”
再看周天雄，盛怒之下忽然一拳朝着陈锋砸来。
周天雄内劲小成的武者，在五口堂算是名列前五的高手了，他乃是华夏有名的门派八级门的弟子。
他的八极拳厉害无比，可以一拳打翻一堵墙。
如今周天雄骨头咯咯作响，目眦欲裂，明显这一拳他已经全力以赴了。
不过没用，而这一次陈锋没有用舌头了，他用手接住了周堂主的这一拳，然后陈锋另外一只手掐住周堂主的脖子，将其举了起来。
“告诉我，你们五口堂另外几个堂主在哪里？你们的总部在哪？”
陈锋看着周天雄的眼睛冷冷的询问道。
“我不知道，有种你杀死我。”
虽然脖子被掐的喘不过气来，四肢也是一阵无力，周天雄但是一个硬骨头，不愿意说出其余堂主的下落。
“呵呵，杀死你太便宜了。”
陈锋冷笑一声，直接将其丢弃在了地上，双脚踩来。
咔嚓！
咔嚓！
他直接将周天雄的双腿踩断裂了，周天雄疼的满地打滚，尿都流了出来，现场满是骚臭味。
“说不说，不说我在踩断你双手。”
陈锋冷冷的道，他知道不用酷刑的话对方是不会说的，虽然也可以用搜魂术搜出对方的脑海里的记忆，不过搜魂术每动用一次需要隔一段时间才能使用，不然会对身体有伤害，毕竟这功法是非常耗费法力的。

“我说，他们在xxx”
周天雄疼的不行，为了避免双手臂也被踩断，他只好说出了其余三个堂主的地址。
content_en:
Time passed bit by bit, about half an hour later, footsteps finally came from outside, and then the door was blown open with a bang, and a person rushed in.
This is a young man dressed in white, with black hair and black eyes. The young man has a stern face. He is Chen Feng.
"I'm here, Hall Master Zhou."
At a glance, Chen Feng saw Zhou Tianxiong sitting on the tiger chair in the hall of the villa, surrounded by many people.
"You are so brave, you came to Wukoutang alone. You think you are Guan Yu, kill him."
After seeing Chen Feng, Zhou Tianxiong said fiercely that after living for so many years, Zhou Tianxiong was the first to encounter such an arrogant person as Chen Feng. He felt very strange and very angry.
If Chen Feng is not killed today, he will simply not be able to survive.
Under Zhou Tianxiong's order, the warriors from the fourth branch rushed towards Chen Feng with weapons or fists in hand, intending to kill him.
For a moment, the sound of killing was loud, and Chen Feng was directly surrounded by so many people from Wukoutang.
Facing the attacks of these people, Chen Feng's body flashed quickly and he avoided the attacks of these people. After all, Chen Feng is an immortal cultivator with powerful spiritual thoughts. His reaction speed is many times that of these warriors, so it is naturally easy to dodge their attacks.
The knives, swords, hammers, and fists in the hands of these gang warriors couldn't hit him at all, and they were always just a little bit away from his body.
Chen Feng did not make a move. Instead, he put his hands behind his back and suddenly flashed behind one of the Nei Jin disciples. He put his mouth behind the other person's head. He stuck out his tongue and hit the other person's head directly with his tongue.
Bang!
With a sound, the back of the opponent's head was directly penetrated by Chen Feng's tongue, and his brain burst and he died on the spot.
Seeing this scene, all the fourth branch warriors were shocked. This was the first time they had seen a tongue kill someone.
Chen Feng kept up his efforts, his body flickered, and each time he flashed to the side or behind the enemy. He opened his mouth and attacked with his tongue, just like a poisonous snake.
Bang!
Bang!
Because Chen Feng was too fast, no one else had time to dodge. In an instant, there were corpses lying on the ground. These warriors were all punched through the temples or the back of the head by Chen Feng's tongue. The dead ones cannot die anymore.
Naturally, they didn't know that Chen Feng was a cultivator of immortality. When he was poured with zhenqi, his tongue turned into a terrifying murder weapon, sharper than a knife.
"Damn it, you are a snake."
Seeing that all his men were dead and stabbed to death by Chen Feng's tongue, Zhou Tianxiong went crazy with rage and felt speechless. This was the first time he saw such a murderer.
Why Chen Feng kills people with his tongue is not because he is a snake, but because he has watched a Japanese cartoon before, and the killer in it kills people like this. He just wants to imitate it and find it fun. He feels that this method of killing is very high-end.
"Fight!"
Looking at Zhou Tianxiong again, he suddenly punched Chen Feng in anger.
Zhou Tianxiong is a martial artist with a small amount of inner strength, and is considered one of the top five masters in Wukou Hall. He is a disciple of the eighth-level sect of a famous sect in China.
His Bajiquan is so powerful that he can knock down a wall with one punch.
Now Zhou Tianxiong's bones were creaking and his eyes were about to burst. It was obvious that he had gone all out with this punch.
But it was useless, and this time Chen Feng didn't use his tongue. He caught Hall Master Zhou's punch with his hand, and then Chen Feng grabbed Hall Master Zhou's neck with his other hand and raised him up.
"Tell me, where are the other leaders of your Five-Kou Hall? Where is your headquarters?"
Chen Feng looked into Zhou Tianxiong's eyes and asked coldly.
"I don't know, you could kill me if you dare."
Although his neck was pinched so hard that he couldn't breathe, and his limbs were also weak, Zhou Tianxiong was a stubborn man and was unwilling to reveal the whereabouts of the other hall masters.
"Haha, it's too cheap to kill you."
Chen Feng sneered and threw it away.On the ground, step on with both feet.
Click!
Click!
He directly stepped on Zhou Tianxiong's legs and broke them. Zhou Tianxiong rolled on the ground in pain and urinated. The place was filled with a stinky smell.
"If you don't say it, if you don't say it, I will crush your hands."
Chen Feng said coldly, he knew that the other party would not tell them without torture. Although the soul search technique can also be used to search out the memories in the other party's mind, the soul search technique needs to be used after a period of time, otherwise it will cause harm to the body. After all, this technique consumes a lot of mana.
"I said, they are at xxx"
Zhou Tianxiong was in terrible pain. In order to prevent his arms from being trampled off, he had no choice but to tell the addresses of the other three hall masters.
